import sys
import os

VENDOR_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "vendor")
# Only load vendor stubs when explicitly testing
if os.environ.get("USE_VENDOR_STUBS") == "1":
    if VENDOR_PATH not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, VENDOR_PATH)
